g.text: "Pain is normal at your age" is NEGLIGENCE with grey hair. Scale: numbers/faces;
PAINAD for dementia (breathing, vocalisation, face, body, consolability). Ladder:
adjuvants (neuropathic) + NON-DRUGS (heat, positioning, physio, massage, distraction,
prayer). Review: pain score + bowels + sedation + function — \"can farm again?\" wins.
CONTINENCE CARE: diary 3 days (fluids, voids, leaks, triggers) → treat cause (UTI,
prostate, atrophic vaginitis, meds, constipation pressing bladder!) → train (timed voids,
pelvic floor, urge-suppression: freeze-squeeze-breathe) → aids (pads sized + skin barrier,
commode, urinal, raised seat) → catheters LAST (retention/ulcers/terminal — aseptic, review
DAILY, remove ASAP — CAUTI kills elders). Constipation: fluids + fibre + move + toilet
routine + review culprits (opioids, iron, anticholinergics) — impaction mimics retention +
confusion (PINCH ME's C!). Dignity: private, prompt, odour-free, never shaming — pads
changed fast, skin guarded (moisture lesions ulcerate).
SENSES: cataract (cloudy lens — REFER: surgery transforms) + glaucoma (silent thief —
screen pressures, drops adherence!) + glasses updated + light + contrast (rails marked,
mats removed); hearing (wax OUT first! then aids + batteries + face-to-face speech); taste/
smell (season food, check gas safety); feet (shoes fit, nails cut, diabetics guarded).
Mouth: dentures fitted + cleaned, thrush treated, dry-mouth sips — chewing = nutrition
(M06). Sensory loss isolates → confusion + falls + depression: aids ON is treatment.
Exam line: \"type the leak, scale the pain, clear the lens and wax — dignity in each.\"
